title: RWB-S5-E1011-APP: the asset slice of RWB-E1-011 has no source for its dependency lists, its ACE-side read, its quality objects, its rights and its run cadence, and the data-lake and Power BI target of the legacy key is removed
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4 dependency classes, R5.5 DP table and R3 source precedence; split_plan.json slice RWB-S5-E1011-APP (H, C, I and X all empty); Work Package B-S5-06 story line; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13 (S5 row), 15 (P1 and P9 contracts), 19 (rwb-asset IN and OUT), 29, 37 and 41 (views read only by rwb-source-data, schema, API, topic and queue of S5); FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 A1.4, A2.1.3.1 (VR-S5-001-1) and A2.6.3.2 (field catalog over v_ace_npa_asset, v_ace_collateral and v_ace_asset); TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T6.1 and T-A.1; FSD P1 Recovery data engine v3 A2.2 (DP06 Collateral and assets, WEEKLY MON 08:00) and A2.11.2 (REC-05 compared on business key, count and amount); legacy RWB-E1-011 sections 2, 4 steps 10 to 12, 12 and 19
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies); Sections 2, 3, 4, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.6, 12.7 and 13
description: One combined row for the story. (1) Dependencies: the DP table adds seven platform CONs (RWB-PLT-E1027-CON for DP-03, RWB-PLT-E1042-CON for DP-06, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON for DP-07, RWB-PLT-E1071-CON for DP-10, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON for DP-14, RWB-PLT-E1044-CON for DP-15 and RWB-PLT-N001-CON for DP-19) and two rwb-case contracts (RWB-P3-E1042-CON and RWB-P3-E1043-CON), while the plan sets H and C to None, so the story cannot state its build or contract dependency from the plan. (2) The ACE side of the check: FSD S5 A2.6.3.2 names recovery.v_ace_npa_asset, v_ace_collateral and v_ace_asset as the module integration point, while Architecture v5 slides 13, 29, 37 and 45 give the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views to rwb-source-data alone and give the S5 row no call to P1; the two sources conflict and the R3 precedence makes Architecture v5 win, so the ACE side must arrive through the rwb-source-data data-product contract, whose element names and paths are not published. (3) The data lake and Power BI are removed, so the reconciliation extract, the data quality extract, the INT-19 outbound adapter and the 07:30 report feed that the legacy publish step relied on have no target and no replacement push operation is named. (4) No event is published, because DP-09 is not in the pattern set, and no operation of rwb-reporting accepts the quality facts, so the hand-off is unstated. (5) No source declares the three quality tables, the check names under REC-05, the run states, the workflow, the two quality read operations or the Schedule cron for rwb-asset; TSD S5 T3.1 declares asset, listing and asset_sale only, and TSD S5 T3.1 names no column that holds the ACE asset key on the asset row while FSD S5 A2.6.3.2 relies on it. (6) Rights: the legacy story gives the job listing Platform administration R, while the TSD S5 T6.1 RBAC matrix declares only the Asset and disposal column and neither grants nor refuses it. (7) Cadence: the legacy run is daily, while DP06 Collateral and assets refreshes WEEKLY at MON 08:00 in the data product catalog, so a business date can fall between two refreshes. (8) Sequencing: the asset rows the run reads are written by the wave-2 and wave-3 asset stories (RWB-S5-E3019-APP to RWB-S5-E4034-APP), while this story is wave 1, Day 1, with no H dependency on them.
evidence: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 rows DP-03, DP-06, DP-07, DP-10, DP-14, DP-15 and DP-19, each naming a platform CON in the Dependency added column; split_plan.json slice RWB-S5-E1011-APP with empty H, C, I and X; FSD S5 A2.6.3.2 field catalog rows v_ace_npa_asset.asset_key, v_ace_collateral.asset_key, v_ace_asset.asset_type; Architecture v5 slide 13 row S5 Asset with targets P7, S4, P8 and S9 only, slide 29 note 'only rwb_source_data has SELECT on the views', slide 37 'Views read only by rwb-source-data', slide 45 'Only rwb-source-data reads the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views'; Architecture v5 slide 19 rwb-asset OUT 'schema rwb_asset: assets taken on, holding, floor price, listings, auction rounds'; FSD P1 A2.2 row DP06 'Collateral and assets | ACE (ingested from CCMS, SVAF, AMIS and RPS) | ... | WEEKLY | MON 08:00'; FSD P1 A2.11.2 REC-05 row 'Business key, count and amount'; TSD S5 T3.1 objects asset, listing, asset_sale only and T6.1 header 'Role | Asset and disposal'; legacy RWB-E1-011 section 12 Output 'extracts reconciliation/<businessDate>.csv and data-quality/<businessDate>.csv to the data lake through the outbound adapter (INT-19)' and section 12 Authorization 'Platform administration R for the job listing'
area: Dependency, data model, API and reporting delivery
proposed: Keep the plan's H and C lists at None, record the nine platform and rwb-case CONs as wave-0 prerequisites and fakes, and read the ACE side of the check as the DP06 Collateral and assets data product of the rwb-source-data contract under the R3 precedence; drop the two extracts and the INT-19 path and serve the facts from GET /api/recovery/asset/v1/quality-results and GET /api/recovery/asset/v1/quality-runs/{businessDate}; accept the three quality tables, the REC-05 check names COUNT, VALUE and KEY, the run states, AssetQualityWorkflow and the asset-key read as the design of this slice; declare the quality reads in Platform administration R and keep Asset and disposal R on GET /assets; run daily on the legacy cadence and gate on the DP06 LOADED answer for the business date in force; build against the fixtures of the wave-2 asset stories and go live with them
